title: Retry, Rate-Limit & Log a Sender (Decorator)
summary: Add retries, a per-recipient sliding-window rate limit and logging to any Sender by wrapping it, in any order.
hints: Each decorator implements `Sender`, holds an inner `Sender`, and is created with the inner one.
Retry: loop `maxAttempts` times, return on the first success, then rethrow (or return) the **last** error.
Rate limit: keep a `Map<recipient, Deque<timestamp>>`. Drop timestamps where `now - ts >= window`. If `size >= max`, reject **without** calling inner. Record the timestamp only after inner succeeds.
Never call the real clock. Use the injected `Clock`, so tests can move time forward.
